resources.string: Help improve Hideout by sharing usage data.

Hideout sends app activity once a day and feature results as they happen to PostHog in the EU, with IP addresses discarded. Events include timing ranges, results, failure categories, import source manager, app version, and operating system. A random installation ID links repeat use. Turn sharing off in Settings → About.

I measure installs, imports, 3D preview loads, and custom game hosting and joining. For modes from Hideout’s custom games list, I also record the mode’s name and ID, whether you hosted or joined, and how long you played in whole minutes. I don’t send Steam accounts, skin or audio mod names or IDs, searches, files, invite codes, or recordings. Modes you host from a local folder are counted but never named. Turning this off stops new collection and clears unsent events. It does not delete events already received.
